question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become the permanent public plugin SDK contract for transient tool summaries?
rationale: Tests and history can establish correctness, but they cannot authorize a new externally consumable reply-payload subtype or decide whether it should remain internal.

options.title: Approve Generic Subtype
options.body: Keep the additive generic constant and predicate, then merge only after exact-head live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep Contract Internal
options.body: Preserve Slack suppression behavior while moving the tool-progress distinction behind a non-public or owner-specific seam.

recommendation.title: Approve Generic Subtype
recommendation.body: Keep the additive generic constant and predicate, then merge only after exact-head live Slack proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history owns the adjacent fast-progress and reply-payload contract that this proposal extends.
